title: National Bankshares, Inc. Declares Semi-Annual Dividend
summary: BLACKSBURG, VA, NOVEMBER 13, 2025: The Board of Directors of National Bankshares, Inc. (NASDAQ Capital Market: NKSH ) today approved payment on December 1, 2025 of a semi-annual dividend of $0.78 per share to all stockholders of record as of November 24, 2025. President and CEO Lara E. Ramsey commented, National Bankshares is proud to offer our shareholders another good dividend payment for the second half of 2025. We are encouraged by improved earnings and the positive impacts of our branch expansion and technology upgrades this year, and we are committed to translating these successes into enhanced shareholder value. About National Bankshares National Bankshares, Inc., headquartered in Blacksburg, Virginia, is the parent company of The National Bank of Blacksburg, which does business as National Bank, and of National Bankshares Financial Services, Inc.
